name: GlucoTwin twin-validity research protocol
registered: 2026-10-23, before any result of this analysis was computed
scope: Synthetic simulator cohort only. Research analysis; the production engine, model weights, benchmark definitions and headline metrics are frozen and are not changed by this analysis.
cohort: bundle.cohort_params of the frozen pipeline (60 patients x 14 days, seed 20261017); patient-level split 36 train / 12 validation / 12 test
model: frozen served models of the production pipeline (trajectory: hist_gradient_boosting; event: logistic_regression), rebuilt deterministically; the rebuilt evaluation report must equal reports/evaluation_report.json apart from generated_at and model_version

A_personalisation_ablation.patients: 12 held-out test patients; every row of the frozen feature table (same rows as the headline evaluation)
A_personalisation_ablation.arm_ablated: carb_sensitivity := the record-based prior for the patient (1.40 + 0.10 x (HbA1c - 7), clipped 0.4-3.0); expected_meal_rise := prior x carbs_on_board; all other inputs unchanged
metrics: trajectory RMSE at 30, 60, 90, 120 min (served trajectory model)
A_personalisation_ablation.uncertainty: paired patient-cluster bootstrap of (ablated - served), 2000 resamples of the 12 test patients, seed 20261023, 95% percentile interval
A_personalisation_ablation.consistency_check: the served arm must reproduce the committed headline values (RMSE 10.40 / 17.21 / 25.90 at 30/60/120; AUROC 0.884) to the reported precision
A_personalisation_ablation.limitation: inference-time ablation of a model trained WITH the personalised inputs: it measures how much the frozen model relies on them, not the value of a model retrained without them

A2_latent_sensitivity_recovery.latent_target: simulator ground truth per patient: mean over that patient's eligible anchors (section B) of the peak difference in noiseless interstitial glucose within 120 min after adding a 40 g meal, divided by 40 (mg/dL per g)
A2_latent_sensitivity_recovery.estimate: engine personal carb sensitivity at the end of study day d (d = 0 is the record-based prior; d = 1..14), computed with the served functions meal_responses and personal_carb_sensitivity
A2_latent_sensitivity_recovery.patients: primary: 12 test patients; secondary: all 60 patients (the engine has no fitted parameters other than the prior constants, which were set on the training split)
A2_latent_sensitivity_recovery.uncertainty: patient bootstrap of Pearson r on the test patients, 2000 resamples, seed 20261023
A2_latent_sensitivity_recovery.limitation: the engine measures total observed rise per LOGGED gram (logging error, background drift, overlapping effects); the latent target is the incremental simulator response to an exact meal. Agreement in rank (correlation) is the primary question; MAE also contains the definitional offset.

B_whatif_ground_truth.anchors: replay offsets 26.0, 35.5, ..., 320.5 h (32 points; identical to scripts/counterfactual_audit.py)
B_whatif_ground_truth.meal_grams_source: carbohydrate values of the Indian meal presets in frontend/src/mealPresets.ts
B_whatif_ground_truth.eligibility: latest CGM <= 180 mg/dL; forecast not withheld; B-23 joint-support status within_training_support for that meal size
B_whatif_ground_truth.prediction: served What-If deltas from TwinService.counterfactual: primary (scenario minus zero-carb meal now; the comparison shown in the dashboard) and secondary (scenario minus no meal)
B_whatif_ground_truth.ground_truth: paired simulator runs for the same patient: identical hidden parameters, identical meal/activity schedule and identical stress-day draws, re-created from the cohort seed; the only difference is an extra meal of exactly g grams starting at the anchor minute, spread over 15 min (the generator's meal duration). Outcome: difference in noiseless interstitial glucose (the generator's 10-min sensor-lag model, before calibration bias and sensor noise) at anchor + h. Reconstruction must reproduce the cohort's stored true glucose exactly before any counterfactual is used.
B_whatif_ground_truth.randomness_control: fully deterministic; no sensor noise in the ground truth (paired design); the meal in the model scenario is logged with exact grams and no delay
B_whatif_ground_truth.baseline: cohort-average static meal response: for each meal size and horizon, the mean ground-truth delta over the 36 TRAINING patients at the same anchors (eligibility: latest CGM <= 180 mg/dL); identical for every test patient and moment
metrics: mean absolute error vs ground truth
Spearman rho between predicted and true deltas across scenarios
direction accuracy: share of scenarios with |true delta| >= 2 mg/dL whose predicted delta has the same sign
B_whatif_ground_truth.uncertainty: patient-cluster bootstrap (12 test patients, 2000 resamples, seed 20261023) of MAE(model) - MAE(baseline)
B_whatif_ground_truth.limitation: agreement of a model trained on this simulator with the same simulator; it tests whether the What-If deltas reflect the simulator's meal physics under controlled conditions, not real-world causal validity

D_low_glucose_lower_bound_audit.rule: fires when any served 80% lower bound at 30, 60, 90 or 120 min is below 70 mg/dL (lower bound = max(forecast - conformal half-width, 40)); fixed before analysis, not tuned
D_low_glucose_lower_bound_audit.outcome: any CGM reading < 70 mg/dL in (t, t + 120 min]
D_low_glucose_lower_bound_audit.patients: validation (12) and test (12), reported separately, overall and by record flag (sulfonylurea or basal insulin vs neither)
D_low_glucose_lower_bound_audit.limitation: a lower prediction-interval bound is not a probability of hypoglycaemia; the simulator under-represents hypoglycaemia (time below 70 recomputed in this analysis)

E_time_below_range: share of CGM readings < 70 mg/dL over all 60 patients, overall and by medication group (sulfonylurea or basal insulin vs neither)
